subject.title: [Bug]: document-extract plugin loads but registers zero capabilities (bundled, 2026.6.1)

question: Should this issue stay open until the linked build PR is resolved and a release includes the document-extractors inspect fix, or should maintainers close it as fixed on current main only?
rationale: Current main fixes the inspect diagnostic, but the latest release does not, the open PR still has closing metadata, and prior maintainer review explicitly did not claim runtime PDF/DOCX extraction was fixed.

options.title: Keep Open Until Release And PR Cleanup
options.body: Leave this issue open until PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95059 is merged without misleading closing metadata or closed, and release/package proof shows the inspect fix is available to users.

options.title: Close As Current-Main Diagnostic Fix
options.body: Close this issue based on the current-main inspect-shape fix while leaving runtime and DOCX behavior to separate issues.

options.title: Split Remaining Runtime Work
options.body: Close the inspect-only portion after release proof and explicitly move any DOCX/Office or runtime extraction concern to the broader document attachment trackers.

recommendation.title: Keep Open Until Release And PR Cleanup
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95059 is merged without misleading closing metadata or closed, and release/package proof shows the inspect fix is available to users.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest recent review and source-history signal for deciding issue state around the merged inspect fix and linked cleanup PR.
